html:
G'oya

Har bir buyurtmadan oy kalitini ajratib olamiz: 2024-02-29 21:30:00 dan '2024-02'. Keyin shu kalit bo'yicha guruhlab, summalarni qo'shamiz. Bekor qilingan buyurtmalar WHERE da, guruhlashdan oldin tushib qoladi.

Yechim

Sanadan matn yasaydigan funksiya ikki bazada har xil: PostgreSQL'da TO_CHAR va 'YYYY-MM' andozasi, SQLite'da strftime va '%Y-%m'.

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(amount) AS revenue
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'paid'
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY month
Faqat SQLiteSELECT strftime('%Y-%m', created_at) AS month, SUM(amount) AS revenue
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'paid'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', created_at)
ORDER BY month

'YYYY-MM' ko'rinishidagi matn alifbo bo'yicha ham to'g'ri saralanadi: '2023-12' doim '2024-01' dan oldin turadi. Shuning uchun ORDER BY month yetarli.

Tuzoqlar

Bekor qilingan buyurtmani CASE bilan nolga aylantirish ham to'g'ridek tuyuladi. Lekin namunada martda faqat bekor qilingan buyurtma bor, bu so'rov esa martni 0 bilan natijaga qo'shib qo'yadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT SUBSTR(CAST(created_at AS TEXT), 1, 7) AS month,
       SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS revenue
FROM orders
GROUP BY SUBSTR(CAST(created_at AS TEXT), 1, 7)
ORDER BY month

Andoza harflarida adashish oson. PostgreSQL'da MM oy, MI daqiqa. SQLite'da %m oy, %M daqiqa. Harf adashsa so'rov xato bermaydi, guruhlar shunchaki daqiqalar bo'yicha bo'linib ketadi.

PostgreSQL'dagi DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) ham oyni ajratadi, lekin natijasi 2024-02-01 00:00:00 kabi vaqt bo'ladi, '2024-02' emas. Uni TO_CHAR ichiga o'rash kerak.

Boshqa yo'l

created_at ni matnga aylantirsangiz, ikkala bazada ham 2024-02-29 21:30:00 ko'rinishida chiqadi. Uning birinchi 7 belgisi aynan oy kaliti, shuning uchun bu so'rov ikkala bazada bir xil ishlaydi:

SELECT SUBSTR(CAST(created_at AS TEXT), 1, 7) AS month, SUM(amount) AS revenue
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'paid'
GROUP BY SUBSTR(CAST(created_at AS TEXT), 1, 7)
ORDER BY month
